description:
Unofficial OpenAPI 3 description of the ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) instance REST surface, authored from the public ScreenConnect documentation and the community PowerShell wrapper github.com/christaylorcodes/ConnectWiseControlAPI.
ConnectWise Control has no first-party OpenAPI document. Its instance exposes RPC-style endpoints under `Services/<Service>.ashx/<Method>` that accept and return JSON. This spec models those endpoints with typed request/response schemas for a usable CLI; each operation's description records the exact JSON wire shape the live `.ashx` endpoint expects (most take a positional JSON array), since the documented endpoints are positional rather than named-field.
Authentication is HTTP Basic with an instance user's credentials. Mutating calls additionally require an `x-anti-forgery-token` header that the instance front page emits; reads generally work with Basic auth alone. The base URL is per-instance (your ScreenConnect host).

tools.name: audit_get-info
tools.description: Returns metadata about the audit subsystem (available event types and retention). Wire format: empty positional array `[]`.

tools.name: audit_query-log
tools.description: Queries audit-log records by session, time window, and event type. Wire format: a positional array carrying the query filter fields. Optional: endDate, eventTypes, includeSessionCaptures (default: false) (plus 3 more). Returns array of AuditEntry.

tools.name: security_delete-user
tools.description: Deletes an instance user. Requires the `x-anti-forgery-token` header. Wire format: positional array `['<userName>']`. Required: userName. Returns the new Acknowledgement.

tools.name: security_get-configuration
tools.description: Returns the instance security configuration, including users and roles. Wire format: empty positional array `[]`.

tools.name: security_save-user
tools.description: Creates a new instance user or updates an existing one. Requires the `x-anti-forgery-token` header. Wire format: a positional array carrying the user record fields. Required: userName. Optional: displayName, email, password (plus 1 more). Returns array of string.

tools.name: session_groups_list
tools.description: Returns all session groups configured on the instance.

tools.name: sessions_add-event-to
tools.description: Queues a session event (such as Wake-on-LAN) against one or more sessions. Wire format: positional array `['<group>', ['<sessionID>'], <sessionEventType>, '']`. Required: eventType, sessionID. Optional: data, group (default: All Machines). Returns the new Acknowledgement.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Numeric session event type to queue.

tools.name: sessions_get-access-token
tools.description: Issues a one-time access token/URL to join a session. Wire format: positional array `['<group>', '<sessionID>']`. Required: sessionID. Optional: group (default: All Machines). Returns the new SessionsGetAccessTokenResponse.

tools.name: sessions_get-detail
tools.description: Returns full detail (connections and recent events) for one session. Wire format: positional array `['<group>', '<sessionID>']`. Required: sessionID. Optional: group (default: All Machines).

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: Returns the live session list for a session type and group. Wire format: the endpoint expects a positional JSON array `[{ 'HostSessionInfo': { 'sessionType': <0|1|2>, 'sessionGroupPathParts': ['<group>'], 'filter': '<search>', 'findSessionID': '<guid>', 'sessionLimit': <n> }, 'ActionCenterInfo': {} }, 0]` and returns sessions under `ResponseInfoMap.HostSessionInfo.Sessions`. Required: sessionType. Optional: filter, findSessionID, group (default: All Machines) (plus 1 more).

params.name: findSessionID
params.description: Restrict to a single session id.

params.name: sessionLimit
params.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

tools.name: sessions_run-command
tools.description: Queues a command or control event on a session. Used to run a shell or PowerShell command on a guest, or to end a session. Wire format: positional array `[['<group>'], [ <commandObject> ]]` where the command object is an event such as `{ 'SessionID': '<guid>', 'EventType': 44, 'Data': '<command>' }` (EventType 44 = QueuedCommand). Running a command requires the `x-anti-forgery-token` header. Required: sessionID. Optional: command, group (default: All Machines), powershell (default: false) (plus 1 more). Returns the new Acknowledgement.

params.name: command
params.description: Command text to run on the guest endpoint.

params.name: powershell
params.description: Wrap the command for PowerShell execution.

tools.name: sessions_update-custom-property
tools.description: Sets one custom property value on a session. Wire format: positional array `['<group>', '<sessionID>', <propertyIndex>, '<value>']`. Requires the `x-anti-forgery-token` header. Required: propertyIndex, sessionID, value. Optional: group (default: All Machines). Returns the new Acknowledgement.

params.name: propertyIndex
params.description: Zero-based index of the custom property to set.

tools.name: sessions_update-name
tools.description: Renames a session. Wire format: positional array `['<group>', '<sessionID>', '<newName>']`. Requires the `x-anti-forgery-token` header. Required: newName, sessionID. Optional: group (default: All Machines). Returns the new Acknowledgement.
